\section{The shape grid}
\label{app:grid}
Table~\ref{tab:grid} lists every configuration of the grid with its mean at $T{=}16$. Each
budget holds five shapes with about the same non-embedding parameter count
$N = 12\,d\,w^{2}$: 20, 50 and 125\,M. Degenerate outputs follow the rule of
\S\ref{sec:method}.
